requirementCoverage.interpretation: Native TypeScript/CSS local page and unchanged supplied fixture
Labeled input, Search button, Enter submission
Initial prompt and visible pending state per request
Result cards and useful empty state
Clear failure and Retry of same failed query
New submission while pending; stale successes and failures ignored
Accessible feedback, keyboard and usable focus
320px fit, scenario checks, setup and supplied output fields

assumptions: Requirement IDs were supplied without individual descriptions; mappings above group the explicit task requirements in order and are author interpretations.
English language and system fonts; no supplied visual identity.
Fresh searches clear previous cards, preserve input edits and focus, and do not cache stale data.
Empty/whitespace submissions are invalid and do not supersede a valid pending query.
decisions: Use a monotonically increasing generation guard on success, rejection and busy cleanup because fixture cancellation is unavailable.
Leave Search enabled during requests so a later submission can supersede an earlier one.
Use a stable polite status outside the busy result region; preserve form/input DOM.
Retry captures the failed submitted query separately from editable input; remains mounted, uses aria-disabled plus handler guard, and preserves focus.
No automatic retries; fixture fail always fails again.
Local-only source copy is byte-identical; no external fonts/assets or installation.
Performance/AT claims are limited to checks actually run.
